title: tailscale CLI is refused by the protected named pipe: unknown, not 'not logged in'
titleZh: tailscale CLI 被受保护命名管道拒绝:unknown,不是「未登录」
why: MEASURED on the reference machine. Two traps in one case: (1) 'tailscale version' exits 0 even here, so a version check must never be read as 'the CLI is usable'; (2) the denial must not be reported as a login or configuration problem, because that sends the user to fix the wrong thing. This case fails if either trap is re-introduced.
inject: version exits 0, while 'ip -4' exits 1 with the ProtectedPrefix access-denied text
expectSummary: TAILSCALE_CLI_LAYER unknown/ts_pipe_denied (never ts_cli_ok, never ts_not_logged_in), exit != 0
